what: `rebase_then_evaluate` defers fixing to a second `monitor()` poll after driver rebase
scenario_or_breakage: Bash runs `run_rebase_rebump` then `run_evaluate_failure` immediately (`scripts/ship-pr.sh:3547-3549`). Re-polling can return `wait`/`pending` while CI is still running and skip the fix path that bash always enters.
suggested_fix: Phase 7 contract: after `goto_rebase` from `rebase_then_evaluate`, call `evaluate_failure` directly (or add a monitor flag) instead of relying only on a fresh `poll_ci`.
